risks.title: Consortium partner withdrawal or major delay
risks.mitigation: Reserve partners, co-leads and early milestone gates.

risks.title: Insufficient learner, apprentice or trainer recruitment
risks.mitigation: Early outreach, rolling recruitment and partner placement commitments.

risks.title: Gender and inclusion targets not met
risks.mitigation: Scholarship and returnship support, targeted outreach and quarterly demographic monitoring.

risks.title: Delayed access to AI Factories or HPC resources
risks.mitigation: Early access agreements, hybrid sandboxes and contingency capacity.

risks.title: Legal, data protection or IP issues with Sector Lab data
risks.mitigation: Pre-approved data agreements, minimisation and early dataset review.

risks.title: Rapid regulatory change creates compliance uncertainty
risks.mitigation: Policy watch, legal review and modular course updates.

risks.title: Low employer engagement for placements
risks.mitigation: Early placement agreements and a distributed employer model.

risks.title: Inconsistent quality across countries
risks.mitigation: Common CCQF templates, trainer certification and peer review.

risks.title: Technology delivery or sandbox failure
risks.mitigation: Reproducible environments, CI tests, staging and rollback plans.

risks.title: Data collection and KPI measurement gaps
risks.mitigation: Anonymised IDs, follow-up reminders and weekly data-quality checks.

risks.title: Budget shortfall or co-funding gap
risks.mitigation: Diversified funding, staged expenditure and rapid forecasts.

risks.title: Reputation or ethical incident
risks.mitigation: Ethics training, supervised use and an incident response plan.

risks.title: Loss of key staff
risks.mitigation: Deputy roles, succession plans and documented handovers.

risks.title: Political or cross-border barrier
risks.mitigation: Early authority engagement and flexible recognition or remote routes.

risks.title: Messaging fails to resonate with target audiences
risks.mitigation: Expert validation followed by audience-focused communications review.

risks.title: Uneven engagement across channels
risks.mitigation: Tailor content by channel and monitor analytics continuously.

risks.title: Technology change outpaces programme updates
risks.mitigation: Monitor advances and update curricula during delivery and packaging.
